engineeringGate: NI-IOBS-L01 remains mandatory before implementing/activating this lifecycle; requirements are concrete source/fixture/selection obligations, not a new user-permission loop.
remainingRequirements: Actual initial issuer and installation: immutable checkpoint2 before corrected Ready/I; no parsed-data authority, caller fresh flag, v1 adoption, or restart recomputation when result absent.

Strict nested codec and hash domains: exact versions/fields/canonical images/ordered issues/targets and same G/frame/request/operation/Ready linkage; validate sibling first, remove exactly that sibling only for full legacy-graph equality; preserve original/checkpoint/Ready.

Prepare the actual whole I result once with real source association and one fallback. Joint prepare-before-write changes legacy ordering explicitly; ordinary I stays unchanged and parse/IO/diagnostic effects need exact future source review.

Phase1 pending-only commit and readback precede any I effect. Phase2 uses stored exact before/after/result and same participating lease plus actual writer/prepared-namespace checks. Unresolved publication/recovery or ownership blocks advance; Committed-with-cleanup-debt is not an absent journal.

Recovery: uncommitted phase2 restores I-before plus Prepared; committed phase2 retains I-after plus Published. NoWrite/Absent still transition pending without writing I or changing its mtime. Retrying stored-byte publication after confirmed rollback is distinct from projecting again.

Actual fresh/resume owner, WRITE/READY association and generation checks must distinguish permitted owned I transition from source drift. Current exact Ready image checks are not automatically compatible with the new I write.

Prepared/Published precedence before generic restore/retry and separately owned terminal handling; common includes exact receipt consumption/linkage and restores Published/I-after on rollback. Unknown bytes/versions/generation retain evidence.

Honest origin bridge into common/cold/late consumer: stored committed result is neither historical public return nor accepted child2 ReturnedNoError. Select and review the new live/resumed-result contract or keep that bridge inactive; never repeat late legacy I on the new route.
